title: Platonic constellations of periodic motions in the $(n + 1)$-body problem
summary: We study the spatial $(n+1)$-body problem formed by one heavy central mass together with $n$ equal masses placed on a single orbit of a polyhedral rotation group $H\in\{T,O,I\}$, so that $n=|H|\in\{12,24,60\}$. Imposing the symmetry $q_{L}=L\,q_{I}$ for $L\in H$ reduces the problem to a single $2π$-periodic reference curve, with reduced action $A_{H}=A_{0}+\varepsilon A_{1}$, in which $\varepsilon$ is the inverse central mass and $A_{0}$ is the Kepler action.
